value.headline: Iran Attacks Kuwaiti Oil Tanker Off Dubai Amid Escalating Strait of Hormuz Crisis
value.detail: Iranian drone attack on Al-Salmi crude carrier signals willingness to escalate strikes on energy infrastructure as Strait of Hormuz remains effectively shut.

value.headline: US Gas Prices Hit $4/Gallon as Oil Tanker Traffic Halts Through Strait
value.detail: Average US gas price has hit $4 per gallon, the highest since 2022, as Iran war has essentially shut off oil tanker traffic.

value.headline: Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady at 3.5-3.75%, Signals Cautious Pause on Easing
value.detail: Fed left rates unchanged at 3.5%-3.75% in March 2026, with only one rate cut projected for full year per updated dot plot.

value.headline: AMD Secures Major AI Deployment Commitments While ASIC Competition Accelerates
value.detail: AMD has secured 6 gigawatt OpenAI GPU commitment and 50,000 MI450 GPU order from Oracle for Q3 2026, contrasting with Intel's foundry challenges.

value.headline: Emerging Market Currencies Face Renewed Pressure as Oil Volatility Drives Safe-Haven Demand
value.detail: EM currency index fell for worst session since November 2024 as dollar and gold surged on geopolitical risks.

value.label: MACRO THEME
value.title: Oil Shock & Inflation Resurgence Risk
value.body: Brent crude surpassed $100/barrel on March 8 for first time in 4 years, peaking at $126 as Strait disruption affects ~20% global daily oil supply. Fed entered wait-and-see mode pausing to assess impact of Iran conflict. Geopolitical premium persists despite diplomatic signals.

value.label: RATES ANALYSIS
value.title: Real Yields Sticky; Rate Cut Window Narrowing
value.body: 10-year Treasury yield at 4.27% on March 18, with Fed projecting only 50bp cuts through 2027 vs earlier expectations. Fed raised 2026 PCE inflation forecast to 2.7% from 2.4% due to oil shock, with 2027 raised to 2.2%. Neutral rate assumptions supporting persistent real yield premium.

value.label: EQUITY DEEP DIVE
value.title: AI Capex Bifurcation: GPU vs ASIC vs Infrastructure
value.body: 2026 marked ASIC acceleration point with in-house silicon outshipping GPUs as hyperscalers pivot to custom chips. Broadcom emerged clear winner with $73B backlog, dominance in ASIC design for Google/Meta internal AI accelerators. Valuation risk rising as consensus becomes crowded in traditional GPU plays (NVDA, AMD).

value.title: US/Israel-Iran War Escalation & Strait Closure
value.detail: War has essentially shut off Strait tanker traffic, disrupting ~20% of world's daily oil supply and prompting 70%+ initial decline in maritime transit. Regime change occurred; military operations ongoing.

value.title: US Tariffs on Canada/Mexico USMCA Uncertainty
value.detail: Canadian economy could enter recession within 6 months if tariffs maintained. USMCA exemption share reached 85% in January 2026, indicating aggressive tariff avoidance by importers.

value.title: AMD ASIC Competitive Threat from Hyperscaler Custom Silicon
value.detail: Custom ASIC shipments projected to grow 44.6% in 2026 vs GPU growth of 16.1%, marking 2026 as ASIC acceleration point. Hyperscalers deploying proprietary TPUs, Trainium.

value.title: Rising Real Yields & Fed Rate Cut Delays
value.detail: Fed revised 2026 GDP growth higher to 2.4% and PCE inflation higher to 2.7%, signaling slower easing cycle than previously expected.

value.title: Emerging Market Currency Stress & Capital Outflows
value.detail: Traders buying protection on EM currencies at fastest pace since COVID-19 pandemic start, signaling severe near-term stress. Central banks in Indonesia, Turkey, India intervening to prevent currency slides.
value.affects: EMFX, EM Equities, Local Currency Bonds

value.title: Credit Spread Widening & Private Credit Stress
value.detail: Global credit spreads widened 4bp in week—largest move since early November—as AI sector default risks cited by investors. Blue Owl down 59% after limiting redemptions in private credit funds.
value.affects: HY Bonds, Private Equity, Credit Markets

value.title: Bank of Japan YCC Exit & JGB Volatility Spillovers
value.detail: Since BoJ abandoned YCC in March 2024, JGB yields risen significantly with 5s30s curve steepening ~120bp. JGB yields rose notably due to political uncertainty and fiscal concerns, with modest spillovers to other economies.
value.affects: JGB, Global Rates, JPY, Carry Trades
